title: Catch My Game
tagline: A decentralized platform to stream games. The platform enables a gamer, of any sport, to share their game or match live with the world and stream tournaments. Users can attend live sessions, watch past recordings, and buy NFTs released from their favorite teams!
description:
Catch My Games is a decentralized platform for all gaming teams to share their game, LIVE. You can either create a stream for the present or schedule a stream for later. One can watch the live streams happening at that moment or choose to watch the previous recordings. at their convenience. 

This stream is not time-bound and anyone who has booked the stream to watch can watch it. One can choose to watch a stream that's happening halfway across the globe and not miss a show of their favorite sport or player wherever they are.

You could extend its application to live stream games that are happening at the current moment in a school, a neighborhood, or at the park. 

The presenter may have the right to create NFTs for certain parts of the video. This could be sold to users who'd want a piece of art based on an experience.
how_its_made: ZORA V3 Protocol, IPFS, NFT.Storage, Livepeer, and Polygon are the technologies supporting this project. This incredible dApp was created using Polygon and the ZORA V3 Protocol to support an NFT market. We maintain long-term storage of NFT metadata with the aid of NFT.Storage. Livepeer has helped the project by giving it the necessary resources to broadcast and stream videos live online.
